### Rate limits
- Store API default POST limit: A default maximum of 25 requests can be made within a 10-second time frame.
- Checkout rate limiting: The limit will be a maximum of 3 requests per 60 seconds.

title: WooCommerce REST API | WooCommerce developer docs
snippet:
WooCommerce (WC) 2.6+ is fully integrated with the WordPress [REST](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Representational_State_Transfer) API. This allows WC data to be created, read, updated, and deleted using requests in JSON format and using WordPress REST API Authentication methods and standard HTTP verbs which are understood by most HTTP clients.

When WooPayments is active, it adds payment-specific endpoints under `/wp-json/wc/v3/payments/`. See the [WooPayments REST API reference](https://automattic.github.io/woocommerce-payments/) for transactions, authorizations, and payouts. Some monetary fields in these endpoints use integer minor units, unlike WooCommerce core's decimal-string values.

Register a free account at https://woocommerce.com, then go to your developer dashboard to generate an API key. Free tier limits are listed above.
